42 def patchify_video(latent, patch_size=(1, 2, 2)):
43     # [B, C, T, H, W] -> [B*t*h*w, C*pt*ph*pw]
44     b, c, t_full, h_full, w_full = latent.shape
45     pt, ph, pw = patch_size
46     t, h, w = t_full // pt, h_full // ph, w_full // pw
47     x = latent.reshape(b, c, t, pt, h, ph, w, pw)
48     x = torch.einsum("nctrhpwq->nthwcrpq", x)
49     return x.reshape(b * t * h * w, c * pt * ph * pw)
50

52 def unpatchify_video(rows, t, h, w, c=24, patch_size=(1, 2, 2)):
53     pt, ph, pw = patch_size
54     x = rows.reshape(-1, t, h, w, c, pt, ph, pw)
55     x = torch.einsum("nthwcrpq->nctrhpwq", x)
56     return x.reshape(-1, c, t * pt, h * ph, w * pw)
